title: FineMotion: A Dataset and Benchmark with both Spatial and Temporal Annotation for Fine-grained Motion Generation and Editing
summary: Adds aligned body-part descriptions for motion snippets and complete sequences, supporting fine-grained generation and spatial/temporal editing.
limitations: Fine-grained caption alignment is distinct from independently captured new action combinations; claimed benchmark gains are paper-reported.

title: The Quest for Generalizable Motion Generation: Data, Model, and Evaluation
summary: Combines mocap, web-derived and video-generated motion in ViMoGen-228K; introduces ViMoGen and hierarchical MBench evaluation.
limitations: Synthetic/video-estimated samples are not independent optical captures; VLM judging requires recording model/version and rendering settings.

title: Go to Zero: Towards Zero-shot Motion Generation with Million-scale Data
summary: Introduces MotionMillion and MotionMillion-Eval for zero-shot, out-of-domain and complex compositional text-to-motion evaluation with a scalable model.
limitations: Dataset size is reported sequence count, not independent captures or unique subjects; the claimed generalization scope depends on the benchmark prompts and training ancestry.

title: What is the Best Automated Metric for Text to Motion Generation?
summary: Studies alignment between automated metrics and human judgments, separating sample-level and average model-level correlation; introduces MoBERT.
limitations: Correlation results concern the studied models/data and human judgments; they do not prove a universal metric for HOI mechanics, timeline compliance or new domains.

title: TMR: Text-to-Motion Retrieval Using Contrastive 3D Human Motion Synthesis
summary: Learns text-motion embeddings using contrastive retrieval and motion synthesis, supplying a retrieval benchmark and evaluator foundation.
limitations: Embedding similarity is evaluator-dependent and does not directly verify contact forces, exact action ordering or object-state effects.
